decisive_argument.name: the A1-vs-null contrast has no resolving power
decisive_argument.detail: The pre-registered DECISIVE-weakens branch requires a valid null AND A1 failing to lift above A0/null. Per divergent seed, A1 minus ARM_NOISE is sign-INCONSISTENT: -0.1173 (s42), -0.0678 (s44), +0.1687 (s46), magnitudes 0.068-0.169 nats, all within or adjacent to the 0.115-0.134 nat band demonstrated reachable by hold-weighting alone (autopsy 699). The pooled mean contrast is +0.0153 nats, 8x below that floor, and its sign is an artefact of averaging seeds whose individual signs disagree. The instrument cannot distinguish A1>null from A1~null from A1<null; the branch taken was unreachable regardless of bias direction.
decisive_argument.why_stronger_than_shortfall_comparison: does not require assuming the contamination is large enough to close a specific gap -- only that it exceeds the gap being resolved, which is measured and not in dispute

targets.recoverability_note: no per-tick sink, no n_fresh_select/n_latched telemetry, no per-tick class stream -- only per-(arm, seed) scalars. The replication factor is unobservable from the recorded emission (699 sec 4e). A corrected re-run is required.

gates.name: frac_pre_ge2
gates.basis: exactly 1.0 on all 24 arm-seed cells -- saturated, nowhere to move

gates.name: named_channel_routing_live
gates.basis: carried entirely by the vigour channel at exactly sqrt(2) on EVERY arm and EVERY seed -- zero variance across all 24 cells -- vs {} / 0.0 when routing is off. A structural constant of project_channel_range (e3_selector.py:124, range computed at :1701), not a measured substrate property. Cuts IN FAVOUR of survival (a constant cannot be reweighted) but it is a BINARY liveness indicator (0 vs sqrt(2)), not a graded magnitude. The 2026-06-29 '1.414 >> 0.001' framing reads as a 1414x margin on a measured quantity and overstates its evidential content: it certifies routing is on and non-degenerate (and does cleanly resolve the 707 vacuous DROP==A1 byte-identity); it does NOT evidence substantial limbic per-candidate competition.

gates.name: loops_carry_live_cross_loop_variance

gates.name: enough_divergent_seeds
gates.basis: cleared at EXACTLY threshold, zero headroom. Input is consumed_summary_pairwise_dist_mean, a continuous mean-of-magnitudes accumulated per env step from CACHED candidates (agent.py:4812, same defect family / MECH-057a). Seed 47's A0 arm misses the 0.05 floor by 0.00064 (1.3%) on the seed with the design's second-worst exposure asymmetry (-23.8%). One seed crossing flips n_divergent 3->4 and changes both C1 and C2 denominators. Independently corroborated: V3-EXQ-708a's queue note flags the identical 3.0/3.0 zero-headroom condition in 708 and adds a guard -- a LINEAGE-WIDE fragility, not a 707b quirk.

learning_extracted: A hold-weighted entropy DV can destroy a finding while leaving the readiness battery intact -- the 699 precedent, now confirmed a second time on a structurally different design. Adjudicate the two separately, always.

Resolving power beats margin arithmetic as a withdrawal argument. The decisive fact was not 'the shortfall is inside the contamination band' (true for only 1 of 3 seeds) but 'the null contrast is sign-inconsistent and 8x below the contamination floor'. The former needs an assumption about magnitude; the latter does not, and holds whichever way the bias runs.

A gate with zero variance across an entire design is a structural constant, not a measurement. vigour = sqrt(2) on all 24 cells survives contamination for exactly that reason -- but its margin language must not be read as evidential content. Zero variance is a prompt to check the generating expression, not a strong result.

Check the admission gate's HEADROOM, not just whether it passed. enough_divergent_seeds at 3.0/3.0 with a 1.3% miss on a fourth seed is a design with no slack, on a statistic from the contaminated cache path. The same zero-headroom condition independently appears in 708 -- a lineage-wide fragility.

A withdrawal's illusory-conflict check must be run against the CURRENT corpus state, not the state at the time of the reading being repaired. 708 sec 5a's fallback lineage was written before the corpus sweep existed; re-checking it converts 'single-legged' into 'no uncontaminated leg'. A repair that names a fallback is only as good as that fallback's own adjudication status at the time of the check.

A withdrawn verdict can already be embedded in an in-flight experiment's DESIGN, not just in prose. 708a dropped an arm on 707b's authority and is running now. Propagation audits must check the live queue and claimed items, not only the document corpus -- and the proportionate remedy is usually to annotate the record, not abort a run whose own question is unaffected.
A derived narrowing falls with the finding that derived it. The DA-gated-arbitration hypothesis survives as biology, but 707b is not evidence for it.
